name: tabs
useFor: Use Tabs to switch between views of the same content (Monthly and Yearly prices, Desktop and Phone previews). Use the default variant for two to four short choices and variant="boxed" for a filter row (All, Features, Fixes). Put each view in TabsContent; controlled tabs take value and onValueChange.
constraints: Panels that slide or fade in
source: The Hoplite website's pricing period switch (.pr-period: Monthly, Yearly, save 17%) and changelog filter (.cl-filter)
title: Tabs
description: Segmented choices: an outlined hexagon holding 32px tabs, the chosen one a filled ink hexagon that slides to it (the pricing period switch), or joined square boxes with the chosen one filled ink (the changelog filter).
